title: IARI Diwali 2026
description: The India Association of Rhode Island (IARI) holds its Diwali 2026 celebration on Saturday, November 21, 2026 at McVinney Auditorium, 43 Dave Gavitt Way, Providence, announced with a save-the-date flyer in the Upcoming Events section of the association's website. The flyer notes this is a members-only event and asks members to please renew their membership.
